connector.name: ego
connector.registryDescription: Write LinkedIn posts in your own voice. Drafts only, ego never publishes for you.
connector.summary: Hosted at ego.dog over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dog.ego, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token created in your ego settings (https://ego.dog/dashboard/settings). Format: Bearer ego_...
